left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Age between 20 years old and 65 years old
  -  Diagnosis of major depressive disorder, [OR]  bipolar disorder, [OR]  and schizophrenia, [AND]  compatible with SCID for DSM-5, with clinical necessity of ECT under a psychiatrist's evaluation and decision
  -  Patients with adequate visual acuity  [AND] and auditory acuity without or with correction
  -  Patients or patients' legal representative signing up the informed consent
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Patients already diagnosed with neurocognitive disorder
  -  Patients with contraindications to ECT, including myocardial infarction, [OR]  cerebrovascular disease, [OR]  elevated intracranial pressure, [OR]  intracranial angiomas, [OR]  untreated bony fractures, [OR]  cervical spine injury, [OR]  pheochromocytoma, [OR]  heart failure, sever valvular disease, [OR]  deep vein thrombosis, etc

right.raw_text:
-  Patients with untreated substance abuse, including alcohol  [OR] and illegal drugs
  -  Patients with unspecified psychiatric disorders
  -  Patients unable to cooperate
